title: Measures Of Money Supply In India
definition: Money supply refers to the total volume of money held by the public at a particular point of time in an economy, categorized by the Reserve Bank of India (RBI) using traditional (M1, M2, M3, M4) and monetary aggregate (NM0, NM1, NM2, NM3) frameworks.
importanceInUpsc: Crucial core microtopic for UPSC Prelims (direct MCQs on liquidity order, components of M1/M3, RBI working group recommendations) and Mains GS-3 (Monetary policy transmission, inflation control, liquidity management).
learningOutcomes: Master foundational concepts and mechanisms of Measures Of Money Supply In India.
Evaluate spatial distribution, institutional frameworks, and policy dimensions.
Apply high-yield mnemonics to solve tricky Prelims and Mains questions.
prerequisites: Basic banking terminology like Demand and Time Deposits
